title: Security Operation Centre Chapter Lead
full_description:
Your role and work environment:
Security Operation Centre Chapter LeadatING Hubs Spainwill support the implementation of ING’s global security strategy within the local hub and will oversee the delivery and improvement of IT security services in the chapter, ensuring alignment with CISO standards and regulatory requirements.
The role focuses on leading a team of security professionals, fostering knowledge sharing, and driving service quality and operational excellence. SoC Chapter Lead will act as a key point of contact for stakeholders, promoting security awareness and continuous improvement.
Key Responsibilities:
Coordinate and improve IT security services within your area (e.g., SOC, IAM, incident response).
Support implementation of security standards and processes in alignment with global CISO strategy.
Monitor service performance and identify opportunities for automation and efficiency.
Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure compliance with security policies and regulatory requirements.
Share knowledge and coach team members to build expertise and craftsmanship.
Assist in onboarding new talents and support their development.
Ensure high-quality delivery of security services and timely issue resolution.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and adoption of innovative technologies.
Maintain clear communication with internal teams and escalate issues when needed.
Foster a culture of security and innovation across ING’s agile organization
Operational Leadership: Manage the day-to-day operations of the SOC, ensuring 24/7 coverage and adherence to Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
Develop and implement SOC strategies and procedures to promote efficient and effective incident response.
Oversee the monitoring and analysis of security events and incidents.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance security controls and processes.
Required Experience and Qualifications:
At least 2 years in a Security Operations Management role, ideally in global environment and at least 5 years of general experience in team management in IT Security
Hands-on experience with global security services (e.g., SOC, IAM, Threat Intelligence, Incident Response)
Communication, flexibility and goal-oriented skills
Being passionate about working with people and developing talents of others make you fulfilled,
Being proactive, innovative, and open to new challenges and technologies (AI, automation).
Analytical thinking skills, initiative and the ability to succeed in a complex environment
Experience with managing relationships with customers and suppliers at senior management levels
Strong communication and presentation skills in English (C1 level).
Proven success in implementing advanced security technologies and automation.
Strong knowledge of security operations and incident response best practices
Familiarity with security tools and technologies (e.g., SIEM, EDR/XDR, IDS/IPS).
It would be a big plus if you have:
Experience with financial sector regulations and audits (GDPR, ISO 27001, NIST).
Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or CISA.
Proven success in implementing advanced security technologies and automation.
